ma.previewImage(Object object)

Preview an image in full screen on a new page.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
urls Array Yes List of image links to be previewed. (The simulator supports only the code package path, network path, and code package path. Note that the code package path is case sensitive.) If a local link is used, ensure that the path does not exceed the root directory of the project.
current String First value of urls No Link to the current image. (The code package path is case sensitive.)
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

ma.previewImage({
  current: '', // HTTP link of the currently displayed image.
  urls: [] // List of HTTP links of images to be previewed.
});
